flashcards.back: A comparison of parts of one whole: 2:3 means 2 parts for one share and 3 parts for the other, with every part the same size.
One equal piece of the split whole: when $48 is shared in 2:3 there are 5 parts, and one part is $9.60.
The full amount being shared: in sharing $48 in the ratio 2:3 the whole is $48, split into 5 equal parts.
The amount one person gets: the number of parts they take multiplied by one part, such as 3 x $9.60 = $28.80.

flashcards.front: A ratio of 3:2 means 3/2 of the whole.
flashcards.back: The ratio parts are mistaken for a fraction of the whole. The whole is 5 parts, so 3 parts is 3 fifths of the whole. In the animation scene s2 the claim is tested against the whole bar and fails: 3/2 of $48 is $72, more than the whole $48, while 3 parts out of 5 is $28.80.
